_comment: Public model metadata and discovery rules. No local machine paths belong in this file.
_sampling_notes: Effective sampling recipes distinguish model-card recommendations from historical local tuning. Installed metadata declares text context; native allocation is default and local context measurements are advisory.

model_families.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MTP (MoE, self-speculative)
model_families._notes: Unsloth MTP build with an embedded multi-token-prediction head — self-speculative, no separate draft GGUF. Measured 77.6% draft accept. Requires llama-server with --spec-type draft-mtp (>= b9610); verified on b10360. The GGUF is named Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf, so only the parent directory identifies it as MTP — the pattern must match the path.

model_families.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Uncensored (HauhauCS Aggressive)
model_families._notes: Third-party abliterated fine-tune, NOT stock Qwen. Registered as its own family so `qwen35` cannot silently resolve to it — any result labelled Qwen3.6-35B-A3B must come from stock weights to be comparable.

model_families.name: Qwen3.8-27B abliterated / uncensored derivatives
model_families._notes: Third-party refusal-ablated fine-tunes of Qwen3.8-27B, NOT stock weights. Registered as its own family for the same reason as qwen3_35b_moe_uncensored: `qwen27` must never silently resolve to one of these, and any number reported as Qwen3.8-27B has to come from stock weights to be comparable. Listed before qwen3_27b_dense because discovery is first-match-wins.

context_policy.evidence: Inherited from qwen3_27b_dense (same Qwen3.8-27B architecture and KV-cache size; weights equal or larger): MLX 131072 prefill OOM observed there. Not separately measured. Recommended working budget set 2026-10-05; raise only with memory evidence.

model_families.name: Altworld Hemmingway-1 (Qwen3.8-27B writing fine-tune)
model_families._notes: Third-party fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B (model_type qwen3_5, same hybrid attention) trained for human-sounding everyday writing: messages, email, short prose. NOT stock weights, so it is its own family and never resolves from `qwen27`; its paths never say 'qwen', so the stock patterns cannot claim it anyway. Sampling is the model card's (temp 1.0, top_p 0.95) with generation_config.json's top_k 20; the penalties match the other Qwen3.8-27B entries. Its chat template defaults to thinking ON at reasoning_effort xhigh when no kwarg is sent and accepts only xhigh, medium or low, so enable_thinking false plus medium is recorded here to reach the server as --chat-template-args. Upstream licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial); some quant cards say Apache-2.0, which the upstream licence overrides.

context_policy.evidence: Inherited from qwen3_27b_dense (same Qwen3.8-27B architecture and KV-cache size; weights equal or larger): MLX 131072 prefill OOM observed there. Not separately measured. Recommended working budget set 2026-10-05; raise only with memory evidence.

model_families.name: Qwen3.8-27B MTP drafter heads
model_families._notes: Speculative-decoding draft heads, not standalone models. The MLX drafters (~0.2-0.5 GB directories) are discovered here so they are not offered as servable models and are not folded into the stock family. GGUF drafters are never registered at all: discover_models._skip_candidate drops files named mtp-*.gguf by design, and the showdown runner passes those by explicit path. Pair a drafter with a target: llama-server --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-model <gguf>, or mlx_vlm.server --draft-model <dir> --draft-kind mtp. mlx_lm 0.31.3 has no qwen3_5_mtp implementation, so the MLX drafters are mlx_vlm-only.

model_families.name: Qwen3.x 27B (Dense)
model_families._notes: Stock Qwen3.8-27B (model_type qwen3_5): hybrid linear/full attention, full_attention_interval=4, so only 16 of 64 layers hold a KV cache. Multimodal (vision_config present) but served as text by mlx_lm. The MLX patterns also admit oQ/OptiQ mixed-precision conversions, which are ordinary MLX safetensors with per-module bit overrides. Two different providers can both ship 'Q4_K_M'; the registry distinguishes them by path, not by quant label. `preferred` records the September 2026 matrix result: oQ4 (4.86 bpw mixed per-module) tied the highest capability at 0.987 while running 33% faster than 6-bit; Q5_K_M dominates Q6_K on capability, speed, size and energy, so Q6_K buys nothing. 6-bit and 8-bit are never defaults and must not be escalation targets — 8-bit was the worst arm measured.

context_policy.evidence: Historical September matrix used 65536 on tested arms; MLX 131072 prefill OOM observed. These observations are not acceptance for every variant or backend. Native allocation remains default. Recommended working budget 65536 set 2026-10-05 from that evidence; raise only with memory evidence (harness-lab Phase 2 context scaling).

model_families.name: Poolside Laguna XS 2.1 (33B-A3B MoE)
model_families._notes: Released 2026-07-02, OpenMDW-1.1. Built for agentic coding on a single machine — the closest direct rival to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on this hardware. Official GGUF at poolside/Laguna-XS-2.1-GGUF (Q4_K_M recommended); community MLX at AtomicChat/Laguna-XS-2.1-MLX-5bit. Sampling values here are the catalog defaults, NOT verified model-card values — check the card before quoting quality numbers.

model_families.name: Cohere North Mini Code 1.0 (30B-A3B MoE)
model_families._notes: Released 2026-06-09, Apache-2.0. 256K context, 64K max output, tuned for agentic software engineering. GGUF uses the cohere2moe architecture, which stock llama.cpp cannot load until PR #24260 lands — build from that branch or the model will fail to load. Sampling values are catalog defaults, NOT verified model-card values.

model_families.name: Gemma 4 12B (Dense, encoder-free unified, 8-bit)
model_families._notes: Same gemma4_unified arch as gemma4_12b_dense; needs mlx_vlm. 8-bit quant split out so `gemma12` is unambiguously the 4bit QAT.

model_families.name: Gemma 4 12B (Dense, encoder-free unified)
model_families._notes: model_type gemma4_unified — encoder-free architecture. Cannot load under mlx_lm; must use mlx_vlm >= 0.6.1.

model_families.name: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B (Dense VLM)
model_families._notes: Dense VLM, not MoE. GGUF requires llama.cpp b10353 or newer; local b11146 supports it. MLX requires mlx_vlm >=0.6.12. Sampling follows the upstream GGUF card checked 2026-10-04 (https://huggingface.co/meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF): temperature 1, top_p .95, top_k 64; neutral penalties. Reasoning cannot be disabled: template opens the thinking channel unconditionally. Control reasoning_strength low/medium/high/xhigh in chat_template_kwargs; default high. Allow sufficient completion budget and preserve reasoning_content across tool turns. Do not add an eom stop string: eom ends a message, not the turn; EOS 200001=end_of_text and 200008=eot. GGUF has an embedded Jinja template and its adjacent mmproj is auto-detected. Context is a declared limit, not a measured memory guarantee. Tools need backend-specific live conformance; registration alone does not prove them.

model_families.name: Prism Ternary Bonsai 27B (2-bit)
model_families._notes: Separate from stock Qwen and Bonsai 2. Installed config is qwen3_5 with affine 2-bit/group_size 128 and 262144 declared context. Historical local non-thinking Qwen settings; these are NOT verified Prism sampling recommendations or a measured maximum. Preserve the installed weights. Text serving via mlx_lm requires a real completion check; vision separately requires mlx_vlm conformance.

context_policy.evidence: Inherited from qwen3_27b_dense (same Qwen3.8-27B architecture and KV-cache size; weights equal or larger): MLX 131072 prefill OOM observed there. Not separately measured. Recommended working budget set 2026-10-05; raise only with memory evidence.
